'''Witenko StarShip Galore''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Witenko]]
* '''Published:''' 30 November 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Docking Bay 94|Premiere-L-tatooinedockingbay94.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Tatooine: Docking Bay 94
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Tatooine Docking Bay 94 Witenko L StarShip.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Its a deck that I play with against my friend.  We have some massive starship battles with this deck of mine and his.  Its lightside by the way. Feel free to give any suggestions or make any improvments that might help me out. all ways looking forward to get better
